queries.expr: topk(100, sum(count_over_time({cluster="Func(name='concat', args=[Lit(value='acme-cluster-'), Attr(name='{{env}}')], where=None, cases=[])"} |~ "(?i)\\[WORKER.ID:.*\\].*" | json | log_level="ERROR" | __error__="" [$__range])))

notes: attribute 'log_level' not in label_map; used 'log_level' — verify the label exists in your stack
FACET aparse(...) has no label equivalent; grouping dropped
filter on 'log_level' assumes it is a parsed json field in Loki

expected.expr: topk(100, sum by (aparse)(count_over_time({service_name=~".+"} |~ "(?i)\\[WORKER.ID:.*\\].*" | regexp ".*\\[TOPIC:(?P<aparse>.*)\\].*" | json | log_level=~"(?i)ERROR" | __error__="" [$__range])))

widgets.title: Incidents
nrql: SELECT count(newrelic.timeslice.value) FROM Metric WHERE metricTimesliceName LIKE 'Custom/workflow_%/incident_%' AND appName= {{camundaAppName}} and k8s.clusterName = concat('acme-cluster-', {{env}}) FACET metricTimesliceName SINCE 24 HOURS AGO TIMESERIES

queries.expr: sum by (metricTimesliceName)(increase(newrelic_timeslice_value_total{metricTimesliceName=~"(?i)Custom/workflow..*/incident..*",service_name=~"${camundaAppName:regex}",k8s_clusterName="Func(name='concat', args=[Lit(value='acme-cluster-'), Attr(name='{{env}}')], where=None, cases=[])"}[$__rate_interval]))
